title: Three Nights and One Short Lens
subtitle: 数据统计 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 数据统计（科学与技术·数据与统计）
meta: 主题语境：数据统计（科学与技术·数据与统计）　|　核心词汇：metre　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 metre 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1971 the observer ① marked the metre that no assistant in the observatory would have described, and he said the marking was the whole of the night. The ② metre, meaning the length itself and not the lens, ran three nights and stayed undescribed in the book; a metre, he said, is the only thing in an observatory that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ metre in that observatory had the same short lens beside it, and the ④ metre at the far dome, meaning the reading they kept for the children to note and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A metre, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the observer said the describing is the part that fills three nights.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the metre was the whole of the matter, meaning the measure and not the length. The ⑥ metre, meaning the measure and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; metre, he said, is either something you mark or the only word that means both a length and a measure. He said the measure is the part they remember.

By 1976 the ⑦ metre had become a line in a log, and the log had become an argument about the short lens. The ⑧ metre of the whole thing, the observer wrote in November, was one observatory and three nights of describing; metre, he said, is either the reading at the far dome or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ metre I remember is the length described in the log, which closed in 1978 and is still described as the quietest in the observatory. A ⑩ metre, my mother said in 1980, is the only length that improves by being described; every metre, she said, is a measure that has agreed to look like a length. She said the measure was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 米；公尺（指观测站里每一段旁边的那一段）
B. n. 米；公尺（指那段米本身，与小小的镜片相对）
C. 固定搭配：mark the metre 标出这一段米
D. n. 米；公尺（指留给孩子们记的那一组）
E. n. 米之事（抽象总称，指一处观测站的米之事）
F. n. 米；公尺（指观测记录里写到、被描述的那一段）
G. n. 米、尺度（指一件事里人人都望却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 尺度（抽象总称，指人人都望却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: marked the metre that no assistant in the observatory would have described
The metre, meaning the length itself and not the lens
the metre at the far dome
the metre was the whole of the matter
the metre had become a line in a log
The metre of the whole thing
A metre, my mother said in 1980

answers.why: mark the metre 意为“标出这一段米”，1971 年那位观测员把观测站里没有一位助手肯描述的一段米做了一遍。
metre 意为“米；公尺”，指那段米本身而不是小小的镜片，它经过了三个夜晚而在簿子上没有被描述。
metre 意为“米；公尺”，指观测站里每一段旁边的那一段，每一段旁边都有同一片小小的镜片。
metre 意为“米；公尺”，指最远那座圆顶的留给孩子们记的那一组，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
metre 意为“米、尺度”，指一件事里人人都望却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这段尺度就是那件事的全部。
metre 意为“尺度”，指人人都望却无人提起的那样东西而不是那段米，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
metre 意为“米；公尺”，指观测记录里写到、被描述的那一段，到 1976 年这一段成了观测记录里的一行。
metre 意为“米之事”，观测员十一月写道，整件事的米之事是一处观测站和三个夜晚的描述。
metre 意为“米；公尺”，我记得的是观测记录里描述过的那一段，1978 年记下了，至今仍被说成观测站里最安静的一段。
metre 为抽象总称，母亲 1980 年说，米是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的米。
